description: Specialized product extraction tool. Use when the user specifically asks what products a crawled brand/site offers, asks for catalog items, variants, product ranges, formulations, product benefits, ingredients by product, or where product claims appear. If the user is asking a general content question rather than enumerating products, use search_content instead. sourceId and domain are optional filters; if you need to discover the right indexed source before narrowing, use list_sources. Returns grouped product mentions with evidence snippets and real page URLs.

domain.description: Optional domain filter, for example physio-relax.de.

productHint.description: Optional known product or brand name to bias extraction and grouping.

query.description: Natural-language query describing the product, brand, category, or benefit to detect.

sourceId.description: Optional crawler source id, for example physio-relax-de.

top.description: Maximum number of search results to inspect for product mentions. Defaults to at least 8.

userLocation.description: Optional approximate user location. Include only if the client or user has explicitly made it available; do not infer or guess it.

country.description: ISO country code when available, for example ES.

timezone.description: IANA timezone when available, for example Europe/Madrid.

name: find_product_mentions
title: Find Product Mentions
